claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda=3/2, N>=4, separated class. Assuming the caterpillar block limits uniformly, the neck slopes, squarefree monomial-window components, and monomial tie moduli keeping roots off 0 and infinity, on a caterpillar region a_j=c_j eps^(j-1) (c in a compact subset of (C^*)^N, eps small) the Wronskian discriminant is a unit times the product over tie components of D(mu(c))+O(eps), mu a monomial modulus; binary faces and monomial-window middle components contribute no zeros. At N=5 the only tie component (the middle one) has Weierstrass polynomial q0+mu q1, whose discriminant is mu^5 times squarefree factors of degrees 4 and 8, so Delta_W^nc vanishes near the caterpillar exactly, and reduced, near the 12 level sets mu(c)=mu_i.
claims.assessment: Conditional on the block limits (windows, minimality) and the caterpillar neck slopes; group factorization of the discriminant with unit cross resultants; exact symbolic discriminant at N=5. Does not reach discriminant components avoiding caterpillar regions.
claims.rationale: First result on the off-collision half of open statement 3: locates and checks reducedness of the discriminant divisor near caterpillar degenerations.
